payload.description_html: Cast of FSAC-KK-11888, currently classified as Spinosaurus, displayed in a swimming posture at the Field Museum of Natural History in Chicago, Illinois. The skeleton reflects the known fossil material as of 2023. The pose is based on 2022 research claiming Spinosaurus was an aquatic specialist and displayed "subaqueous foraging behaviour."
